title: Enterprise Meeting Intelligence, Speaker Diarization, Hotword Boosting & CRM/Jira Sync Architecture Benchmark

tiers.name: Tier 1: Single-Channel Mixed Audio + Generic ASR + Blind Direct CRM Write
tiers.verdict: Anti-Pattern: Confuses buyer vs seller (22.4% DER), mangles SKUs (28.5%) & pollutes CRM (19.2%)

tiers.name: Tier 2: Acoustic-Only Diarization on Mixed MP3 + Prompt Post-Correction
tiers.verdict: Fails on overlapping speech & conference rooms; LLM guesses phonetic SKU typos poorly

tiers.name: Tier 3: Full 60-Min Raw Audio Streamed Directly to Frontier Audio LLM
tiers.verdict: Prohibitive $420K/mo audio token bill for 100K hours & lacks exact word-level timestamp anchors

tiers.name: Tier 4: Per-Track RTP + Voiceprint Room Split + CRM Hotword Boost + Staged 1-Click CRM Card
tiers.verdict: Recommended: 1.4% speaker error, 2.2% SKU error, 0.4% CRM noise & $24.5K/mo (-87.4% vs Tier 1)
